'''Clan Kryze''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan in existence during the final [[Galactic Standard Calendar|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Mandalorian Civil War (True Mandalorians)|Mandalorian Civil War]]&mdash;a conflict of ideology waged between the crusading [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] and the reformist [[True Mandalorians]], while the pacifistic [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] remained apart and neutral&mdash;members from Clan Kryze could be found in support of each of the three factions, as opinions were divided among the clan.<ref name="TEGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

In the [[Great Clan Wars/Legends|Great Clan Wars]] that followed the Mandalorian Civil War, when the Death Watch moved against the New Mandalorians after emerging victorious over the True Mandalorians, the [[Satine Kryze's father/Legends|Duke]] of Clan Kryze was killed. His [[Parent/Legends|daughter]],<ref name="ShadowConspiracy">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref> [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalevala/Legends|Kalevala]], later become a [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] and rose to become the [[Anti-Mandalore|leader]] of the New Mandalorian faction on the Mandalorian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] by the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|start]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Ruling from the [[Domed city/Legends|domed]] New Mandalorian [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], Satine was forced to combat the return of the Death Watch,<ref name="TMP" /> among their ranks her estranged sister, [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan Kryze]].<ref name="Lawless">{{TCW|The Lawless}}</ref> Satine's nephew, [[Korkie Kryze/Legends|Korkie Kryze]], also lived in the city of Sundari, where the [[Gender/Legends|boy]] attended the [[Royal Academy of Government/Legends|Royal Academy of Government]].<ref name="Academy" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Satine Kryze first appeared in the [[2010]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television episode "[[The Mandalore Plot]]," and her nephew, Korkie Kryze, first appeared in the series' later episode, "[[The Academy]]," that same year. However, it was only with the release of ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], that Clan Kryze officially entered ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]]. A year later, with the release of ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' on [[October 15]], [[2013]], Clan Kryze was mentioned again.
